members.title: Jensen Huang is out. What did China want from him?
members.content: Today, we’re talking about the Jensen Huang scandal at Nvidia, which is developing so quickly that we had to do an emergency update of this intro minutes before publishing this episode.Huang just resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia as news of his affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy, threatened to engulf the company.We’ll have more on that story as things develop and we learn how Nvidia will restructure itself after Jensen — he had something like 60 direct reports, after all, and the entire AI financial ecosystem flows through the company.

members.title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
members.content: The open source community just lost one of its strongest advocates. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned Thursday after he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the motives behind the executive’s support for softer chip export controls on China. Huang has been a staunch supporter of open source AI, framing the ecosystem as good for safety, innovation, diffusion, and sovereignty.

members.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
members.content: Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and U.S. national security. U.S. officials believe that one of Huang’s likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing.

members.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
members.content: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue briefly commented on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s departure on Thursday, calling it a “really sad day.” Nvidia had announced its plan to acquire the platform for open source AI models in September for $12.9 billion, making it the second-largest acquisition in the company’s history, just behind that of chipmaker Groq’s assets for $20 billion in December 2025. “This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day! But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever.

members.title: Google推出Gemini4Hydrogen，全球Search迎来最大模型升级Google推出Gemini4Hydrogen，并引入全球Google Search，称这是Search迄今最大规模模型升级。它重点提升搜索处理多部分、复杂细节及拼写错误的能力；与侧重复杂推理的Gemini4Carbon、Gemini4Argon不同，Hydrogen面向高速代理式工作流，能自主完成多步骤任务，速度比Gemini3.8Flash快2.5倍。 刚刚 7.9K
members.content: Google宣布推出Gemini4Hydrogen，并将其引入全球Google Search，重点提升搜索引擎处理多部分、复杂细节及拼写错误问题的能力。Google称，这是迄今为止Search最大规模的一次模型升级。与专注复杂推理的Gemini4Carbon和Gemini4Argon不同，Hydrogen主要面向高速代理式工作流，能够自主完成多步骤任务。Google表示，其任务执行速度比上一代快速模型Gemini3.8Flash快2.5倍。在默认高思考等级下，Hydrogen在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index基准测试中的表现甚至超过能力定位更高的Gemini4Argon。在搜索场景中，Hydrogen能够更准确地理解用户意图、遵循指令和调用工具，并优化Search的扇出技术，将复杂提示拆分为多个子查询，以发现更多相关网站。Google AI Mode也将提供更多图片、结构化答案、对比表格及定制工具，进一步改善多语言搜索体验。Hydrogen支持低、中、高和新增的超高（xhigh）四档思考等级，旨在减少输出Token消耗并提高任务执行效率。在Agent Arena基准测试中，其在深度研究、数据分析和大型代码库导航等多步骤任务中排名第五。此外，该模型还可自主编写代码、运行测试并验证代码修改，也能与Carbon、Argon协同完成工作流。

topic_dossiers.topic_title: 三星与 Google 推出 AI 智能眼镜

members.title: Samsung联合Google推出AI智能眼镜，12月10日正式开售三星电子推出与Google合作开发的智能眼镜系列，2026年12月10日开售，11月12日开启预订。搭载Google Gemini，联合Gentle Monster和Warby Parker推出30款设计，支持免提AI交互，可回答环境问题、翻译文字，并通过Google Maps提供逐步导航。整机约41克，配1200万像素HDR摄像头、开放式扬声器和4个麦克风。 刚刚 8.1K
members.content: Samsung Electronics宣布推出与Google合作开发的智能眼镜系列，产品将于2026年12月10日正式开售，并于11月12日启动预订。该系列搭载Google Gemini，联合Gentle Monster和Warby Parker推出共30款设计，支持免提AI交互，可回答有关周围环境的问题、翻译文字，并通过Google Maps提供逐步导航。硬件方面，眼镜整机重量约41克，配备1200万像素HDR摄像头、开放式扬声器和4个麦克风。Samsung表示，单次充电续航最长可达9小时，搭配充满电的充电盒，综合续航最长可达72小时。产品可与Galaxy手机配合使用，借助连接设备处理部分运算任务。隐私与安全方面，摄像头工作时会亮起指示灯，并提供额外的视觉和声音提示;如果指示灯被遮挡或无法正常工作，系统将禁用摄像头拍摄功能。用户可以管理应用权限及Gemini活动，眼镜采集的影像不会用于AI模型训练或定向广告。用户询问Gemini有关眼前事物的问题时，系统还会在回答前对旁观者面部进行模糊处理。设备激活和应用下载需要年龄验证，产品面向18岁及以上用户。美国市场方面，Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear起售价为395美元，Gentle Monster Intelligent Eyewear售价为449至489美元，具体取决于型号。

members.title: Google pushes privacy angle as Gemini-powered smartglasses debut starting at $395
members.content: Smartglasses have always faced an uphill road to acceptance. Not only is propping a computer up on your nose an uncomfortable proposition, but the privacy aspect has been vexing people since the Google Glass days. Now, Google is ready to take another swing at “intelligent eyewear” for the Gemini era after previewing its plans a couple of times. The first glasses are up for preorder today from Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, but they’re no impulse buy. These devices are a collaboration between Google, Samsung, and the aforementioned eyewear designers.

members.title: Anthropic推出Claude Meetings，可加入Google Meet参与会议Anthropic推出Claude Meetings，用户可将Claude作为可见参与者加入视频会议。会议中它能实时答疑、生成文档与白板、记录笔记和待办事项；默认以文本回复，获授权后可访问连接工具，协助信息整理与任务处理。会后，生成的笔记、记录及文档统一保存在claude.ai。该功能拓展了AI在协同办公场景的应用。 刚刚 6.7K
members.content: Anthropic推出Claude Meetings功能，允许用户将Claude作为可见参与者加入视频会议，使其能够在通话过程中实时回答问题、生成文档和白板、记录会议笔记及待办事项，进一步拓展AI在协同办公场景中的应用。会议期间，Claude默认以文本形式回复，并可在获得相应授权后访问已连接的工具，协助完成信息整理和任务处理。会议结束后，Claude生成的笔记、记录及文档将统一保存在claude.ai的专属页面，方便用户后续查看和使用。隐私方面，系统默认禁止Claude加入包含外部参与者的会议，以降低未经授权的信息访问风险。目前，Claude Meetings正面向Team团队版和Enterprise企业版用户开展测试，暂时仅支持Google Meet，Anthropic表示未来将扩展至更多会议平台。此外，采用HIPAA合规配置或客户自行管理加密配置的组织暂时无法使用该功能。此次更新延续了Anthropic将Claude打造为一体化办公工具的产品方向。此前，公司已陆续推出白板、数据仪表板等功能，并持续拓展会议记录和协作能力，推动Claude从对话式AI助手向覆盖会议、文档及数据处理的工作平台演进。

members.title: Claude 正式推出全新会议功能：作为可见参会者直接加入视频通话，率先面向团队版与企业版开放测试Claude推出测试阶段会议功能Claude Meetings，面向Team和Enterprise套餐开放，标志AI进一步打破办公协同应用边界。该功能让AI以可见参会者身份直接加入通话，深度融入日常办公流程，改变以往仅能在会后生成会议纪要的局限。其具体运行机制原文未完整呈现。 刚刚 0
members.content: 人工智能在办公协同领域的应用边界正在被进一步打破。近日，人工智能企业Claude宣布推出处于测试阶段的全新会议功能——Claude Meetings。该功能目前已正式面向 Team（团队版）和 Enterprise(企业版)套餐开放。核心功能与运行机制:作为可见参会者直接加入通话作为一款深度融入日常办公流的创新功能，Claude Meetings彻底改变了以往 AI 只能在会后生成会议纪要的局限。在具体的运行形态上，Claude Meetings允许Claude直接作为一名可见的参会者加入实时的视频通话中。通过这种方式，AI 不仅能够在后台默默记录和分析讨论内容，还能以直观的参会身份参与到团队的实时协作与互动场景中。面向高阶套餐开放:持续拓展企业级协同生态在面向的用户群体方面，该功能目前处于测试阶段，并精准面向购买了 Team 和 Enterprise 套餐的企业级用户推出。业内分析人士指出，随着各大科技巨头纷纷加码办公场景的智能化改造，将 AI 实时引入视频会议将有助于进一步打破信息孤岛、提升团队沟通与决策的效率。随着本次测试的开启，未来这一功能也有望为企业用户带来更加流畅和沉浸的智能协同体验。

members.title: No, AI agents did not discover a previously unknown Maya site
members.content: Armed with a team of AI agents, Google researcher Pietro Miotti claimed earlier this week to have discovered a potentially unmapped Maya site in Mexico. There was just one problem: The site had already been discovered and was published in an academic journal last year. The incident, which sparked criticism among archeologists online, underscores a growing tension in science as amateurs wielding increasingly powerful AI tools parachute into specialist fields, often without the expertise needed to understand what they are looking at.Local communities are often already well aware of sites in thei。

members.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
members.content: Introducing TOME-Math, a large-scale mathematical proof supervision corpus built from 2,118 university-level textbooks, containing 380K structured QA records. Unlike conventional math datasets that flatten knowledge into isolated question-answer pairs, TOME-Math preserves chapter progression, proposition-proof dependencies, and intermediate proof obligations. 🚀 Key findings: +16.7 percentage points in average performance across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Structured curriculum learning improves reasoning even with the same training data.

members.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
members.content: Most LLM routing approaches select a single model per prompt, while ensembling introduces a different question: which models should we combine, and how many are actually worth invoking? In this paper, we introduce PISA, a cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, which extends routing to ensembles with prompt-adaptive composition and size. PISA-E estimates ensemble utility from individual model capability predictions, without requiring ensemble-specific training. It then selects the models to invoke based on the prompt and a configurable cost–quality preference.
